channel.title: Game news (ctrl-agame.com)
channel.description: Verified gaming news from every platform: launches, free games, deals and updates. Every story links to its official source.

item.title: Xbox Wire: buy by November 19 for the Vintage Vice City Pack and one month of GTA+
item.description: For purchases before 23:59 on November 19; pre-install is open on Xbox.

item.title: Wolfenstein 3 officially announced, in production at MachineGames
item.description: At Xbox's 25th anniversary event, Wolfenstein 3 was confirmed to be in development at MachineGames.

item.title: Nintendo Black Friday: Switch 2 + Mario Kart World bundle at $499.99
item.description: Digital game sales start November 19, with the Mario Kart World bundle and physical game deals from November 22 (US).

item.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting Firefight in a free update
item.description: The four-player co-op PvE mode Firefight arrives this winter as a free update.

item.title: YouTube hosts a 24-hour launch livestream
item.description: The pre-show starts at 11 PM ET on November 18 and it ends live from Miami.

item.title: Knightica is free on the Epic Games Store until November 19
item.description: Epic's weekly freebie is Knightica until November 19; Alien: Isolation and Mark of the Deep follow on November 19.

item.title: PS Plus Game Catalog for November: Death Stranding 2 and Like a Dragon join
item.description: The PlayStation Blog revealed the November Game Catalog, led by Death Stranding 2, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii and Atomfall.

item.title: Marathon's Symbiosis update lands December 8 with new PvE and PvP modes
item.description: Bungie set the Symbiosis update for December 8, adding new modes, weapons and a new Runner shell.

item.title: Football Manager 27 is out now, including with Game Pass
item.description: FM27 launched on Xbox on PC and FM27 Console on Xbox Series X|S, both available with Game Pass.

item.title: Nintendo eShop adds digital game gifting for family groups
item.description: From November 16, family group members on Switch and Switch 2 can gift digital games to each other.
